entries.content: Hyalite: SDF lens map + SVG feDisplacementMap real-time refraction. Two-level cache (geometry buckets + filter reuse). Two-pass anti-staircase split for Chromium nearest-neighbour staircase. Per-corner radii exact. Map = PNG data URL (R=x, G=y, B=rim).

Vercel design.md: three-part on-brand system — design.md (public URL guidance, named anti-patterns) + CSS stylesheet (constrained primitives: classes/tokens) + eval loop (7 scenarios, blind A/B, deterministic checks + model judge). 57% failure reduction. Evaluated on Claude Opus 4.8 + Codex GPT-5.5. Key insight: guidance changed structure/hierarchy, not just styling.

Skill distribution: SKILL.md instruction injection — single file bundles task-specific capability (trigger words, preconditions, steps). GitHub repo as distribution unit. .opencode/skills/ directory convention. Multi-skill orchestration: brainstorming → TDD → code-review → dispatching-parallel-agents.

Colibrì ExpertStore: 3-tier placement (VRAM hot / RAM warm / NVMe cold), each with independent LRU cache + persistent affinity tracking. LFRU eviction (low-frequency-first, recency-breaks-ties). PilotPrefetcher: 71.6% accuracy, async I/O worker threads, heatmap ordering for SSD locality. LeaseManager: formal borrow/release semantics, RAII LeaseGuard, timeout auto-reclaim.

SysData ProbeRegistry self-audit architecture: one StorageProbe per category returning StorageItem + Safety badge (Safe/Review/Manual) + ReclaimAction. 180 items across 18 categories. History delta tracking (growth/deletion). Trash-first for review items. --json CLI output. Catch-all probe fills gaps.

[NT-PHYSICAL] Clay Safari: Blender Python parametric modeling (20-40 lines/model, 19 models in ~10s) + procedural world gen (value noise terrain, instanced vegetation, vertex-color paint) + zero external assets. MeshPhysicalMaterial sheen for clay feel. Web Audio synthesis for 17 sounds. GLB export with pivot() joint origins.
Ripwire: lightweight agent network isolation sandbox for untrusted code execution. Egress control with per-agent network rules.
Tel-Agent: LLM-driven telephony agent with voice interaction, real-time conversation, and multi-turn state management for phone-based AI interaction.

Multi-agent DAG orchestration: task decomposition + dependency graph + parallel execution + result merging. GenOffice: office automation. SuperHermes: multi-agent collaboration with cross-platform integration.
NVIDIA SkillSpector: skill validation framework — quality scoring + compatibility detection + security audit for AI agent skills. Automated skill health checks.
Pumpkin MC: Rust high-performance Minecraft server. Async IO + zero-copy + ECS architecture. Demonstrates Rust game engine patterns for high-concurrency real-time systems.
Excalidraw: infinite canvas + real-time collaboration + vector graphics + WebSocket sync. State serialization for offline/online. Whiteboard-as-code paradigm.
[NT-PHYSICAL] MuJoCo: DeepMind physics simulation engine. Contact dynamics + joint constraints + GPU acceleration. Standard for robotics sim. Rust bindings available.
Adversarial AI security: red team testing framework + prompt injection defense library + model robustness verification. exploitarium and adverserial.ai provide complementary approaches.
FineWeb-10B: large-scale pretraining dataset processing + data cleaning pipeline. Qdrant vector store integration for semantic search at scale.
Skyvern: browser automation with visual understanding (screenshot→action mapping) + workflow orchestration. Computer-use agent paradigm.
[NT-PHYSICAL] ciechanow.ski: interactive physics visualization (fluid/collision) + pedagogical engineering documentation. Sets bar for technical content quality.
OpenInterpreter 01: local code executor with sandboxed multi-language runtime. Agent can execute Python/JS/shell locally with safety controls.
browser-act skills: anti-detection browser automation — stealth browsing + fingerprint spoofing + proxy rotation for agent web interaction.
Ollama containerized deployment: Docker/Podman templates for local LLM serving with GPU passthrough. Integrates with LlamaProcessManager auto-start flow.
